guides.title: Bulk Invite Employees in SafetyAtlas

Click "Open" A notification appears, stating the employees have been uploaded. Confirm that the employees were invited. Open "Pending Invitations" The users will appear at the top of the Pending Invitations list.

guides.title: Certificate Configurator (CH)
guides.text: Navigate to https://steve-admin.nsc.org/ Click Certificate Configurator. Certificates can be searched based on their name. Certificates can be sorted by selecting the column title of Template, Status, or Updated. Click on the desired certificate template. Example: "VLT Certificate" A preview of the certificate is visible at the top of the screen, click "Edit" to make changes. The section of "Template details" allows for changes to the basic certificate information. Once the desired changes are made click "^" to minimize the section. "Section 2" is the main body of the certificate. Line items can be updated, moved, added, or removed from the section. Once the desired changes are made click "^" to minimize the section. "Section 3" is the certificat footer. Line items can be updated, moved, added, or removed from the section. Once the desired changes are made click "^" to minimize the section. Click "Save Template" Click "Save Template" The error notification appears in the top right corner of the screen. Click "Add new" A preview of the certificate is visible at the top of the screen.\ As changes are made to the sections the certificate will update in real time. "Template name" and "Background image" are both required fields. \ "Available" defaults to active.\ "Description" is an optional text field that can be used to provide additional informatoin about the certificate. Select the "Certificate Title" field to input the desired title and click "Done" Select the "Oraniztion Name" field to input the desired name and click "Done" Fields can be reordered by using the arrows on the right hand side or by dragging and dropping with the dots on the left hand side. Select the "Completion Seal" field to input the desired word(s) for the Seal and click "Done" Section 1 has an option to "Add to section"\ All fields for Section 1 are automatically created and added. If a section was removed it can be re-applied. Each field is indicated as "Static" or "Dynamic". "Static" means the wording in the text box will remain the same on all certificates.\ "Dynamic" means the information is pulled from the Student's profile. Additional fields can be added to the section by selecting "Add to section" Fields that are not already on the certificate will appear in black. Fields that are on the certificate will appear in grey and state "USED" "Section 3" is the footer/bottom portion of the certificate. Additional field(s) can be added by selecting "Add to section" and clicking on the desired field. Click "Save Template" If a required field is missed a notification will appear in the top right stating, "Please fix the highlighted errors before saving." Red text appears in the field sections that need to be adjusted. Once the called out field sections have been update, click "Save Template" A notification appears stating the template has been created. The created certificate template will appear at the top of the list of templates.

Click "Save changes" Click "Orders" All orders placed by the Organization are visible. \ \ Orders can be searched based on order number or item name. \ Orders can be filtered based on date, type, payment status, and status.\ Columns can be sorted chronologically by clicking the column header of date or amount. Click "Courses" All courses purchased by the organization are visible. Courses can be searched based on course name. \ Orders can be filtered based on availability.\ Columns can be sorted alphabetically by clicking the column header of Course Name, Format, Total Seats, Assigned Seats, or Available Seats. "View Notes" shows the history of the course's inventory with reference to the Order Number. Click the pencil icon of a note to make changes and then "Save" Click "Close" Click "Manage" next to the desired course. Click "Learners" All learners associated with the organization are visible based on their status with the organization. The learner's can be searched for based on first name, last name, or email address. The learner's visible can be filtered based on: has assigned course, past due, and has completions. Columns can be sorted alphabetically by clicking the column header of First Name, Last Name, Email, Department, Location, Assigned, Completed, Overdue, or Status. "Learners" tab allows for NSC Administrator to add a learner to an organization. Click "Add New" to invite a new learner to the organization. This is also a feature that the organization administrator has. The ability to add learner(s)/employee(s), has two options. 1. Add a single employee by selecting "By Email" 2. Add multiple employees by selecting "Upload CSV" Click on the option that best fits the customer's request. This example is for an individual, click on "By Email" Fill in the information for all required fields. Required fields are marked with a red astrict. "Role" defaults to "User" but can be updated to "Admin" When all desired fields and required fields are entered, select "Send Invite" A notification at the top of the screen will appear confirming the invitation, or stating why it was not sent. "Pending Invitations" shows learners who have been invited to join the organization but have not responded to the email invitation. "Disabled Learners" show the learners who have had their accounts disabled but were part of the organization. Click "Disable Admin Access" to have the user's access reduced to an organization learner. Administrator's can also be returned to Learner status by using the toggle under "Admin Access" Click "Cancel" to keep the user as an administrator. The seats can be searched based on "Course Name" and filtered based on Availability. Each course displays on a tile reflecting an overview of the course and the seat division. To assign a course seat to a learner, select "Assign" on the correct course tile. The organization's learners will appear on the screen with the ability to search based on a learner's name or email address. The learners can be filtered based on Department and/or Location. The list of learners can be sorted based on the quantity of coures Assigned, Completed, and Overdue. To select individual learners click on the box to the left of the learner's name. To select all learners click on the box to the left of "Name" in the green banner. Once the desired learner(s) are selected click "Continue" The length of time the learner(s) have access to course can be selected. "No due date" means the learner(s) will have access to the course material indefinetly. "Quick range" gives the options of 30 days, 60 days, or 90 days of acess. "Due date" can be manually updated to be a unique period of time. Once the desired course access period has been determined, click "Continue" The screen will show an overview of the selections made. guides.title: Training Centers (NSC)
guides.text: Navigate to https://steve-admin.nsc.org/ and ensure Module is set to SAFETYATLAS Click Training Centers. Training Centers can be searched by their Name or Address. \ Training Centers can be filtered by their status. \ Training Centers can be sorted alphabetically by selected the column title of Name or Address. Open the Details tab to view the Training Center's general information. Click Edit Training Center to make changes to the general information. The Training Center can be deactivated, the name can be updated, and can be a private or public location; with the Description is optional. The training center's full address and contact information is required. However, a direct contact name and notes are optional. Ordering refers to who the Training Center orders supplies through.
